description: On the green-covered table there are small piles of colorful beads, a tall gray cup, and a partially strung line of dark blue beads. The left hand steadies the blue-bead strand near the cup while the right hand reaches to the right to pick up a small cluster of blue beads, then brings a single bead to the strand and slides it onto the string, briefly pinching and adjusting the strand with both hands before the right hand releases.
